notes: Durable M1-M7 workflow ledger. Status reflects the SPEC section 16 acceptance, not effort spent. Each milestone gets a fresh agent and its own branch; update the matching entry (status/evidence/remaining_gates) in the same commit that advances it. Complete means the acceptance is genuinely met, not that sample checks pass.

milestones.name: Repo skeleton, CI, download + parse for 5 medicines EN+EL
milestones.acceptance: Section-coverage tests pass; side-effect tables readable; licence wording confirmed
evidence: 10/10 corpus files resolved, downloaded, language-verified and sha256-pinned in data/medicines.yaml; SmPC 28/28 plus required leaflet sections present for all five medicines in EN and EL.

Grid-table first-column frequency loss fixed: extract_tables_for_pages surfaces PyMuPDF page-span font weight per cell; bold first-column-only rows stay system-organ-class headings, regular ones become 'Reaction - <column 1 frequency>'. Verified on the real xarelto_en PDF (Eye haemorrhage - Common, Hypotension, haematoma - Common) and pinned by unit + corpus tests.

Local: MEDLEAF_M1_CORPUS=1 MEDLEAF_SMOKE_PDF=data/raw/xarelto/xarelto_el.pdf PYTHONPATH=src python -m pytest -q -> 34 passed, 0 skipped; default offline run -> 21 passed, 13 skipped; 'ruff check .' clean.

.github/workflows/ci.yml added: push/PR runs Ruff + fast tests only; the EMA corpus is an explicit manual workflow_dispatch opt-in that downloads the assets before running corpus tests, so CI never claims untested corpus coverage.

Official EMA legal notice and quoted terms recorded in docs/M1-acceptance.md; code is MIT while the corpus PDFs remain EMA copyright with attribution; no blanket legal or clinical clearance is claimed.

GitHub Actions CI run 38748946549 on commit 8bdce22 is green: 'lint and fast tests (no corpus)' succeeded; the manual opt-in corpus job was skipped by design. https://github.com/NickLitharis/medleaf-rag/actions/runs/38748946549
